notes: Pages open faster. A page you have opened is shown at once when you come back to it: its numbers are kept until a new scan arrives or you save something, and after a scan the pages you opened lately are worked out again behind the scenes. Before, the gear summary took about 4 seconds on every click, the plan about 4, Invest about 2.
The first opening after a scan is shorter too: the first page 12 seconds before, about 2 now; a walk through every page 43 seconds before, 12 now.
